content.rendered:
NoMa Farmers Market at Third Street

Join friends and neighbors from April 30-October 29, 2026 to shop for fresh produce, farm-raised meats, cheeses, freshly baked goods, and dozens more unique, locally made foods and goods.

NoMa Farmers Market at Third Street


Join the NoMa BID at the NoMa Farmers Market from April 30 – October 29 on Thursdays from 4:00 – 8:00 p.m., located on Third Street NE, where you’ll find fresh produce, quality meats, and artisanal goods. Grab ready-to-eat meals and treats while enjoying live music and outdoor seating. Conveniently located near the NoMa-Gallaudet Metro and Union Market, it’s perfect for evening commuters and locals alike!

Produced by Diverse Markets Management

Diverse Markets Management, LLC (DMM) is a DC-based firm specializing in the development, programming, and management of outdoor public exhibitor markets and special events. The firm is experienced in specialty vending, managing relations with this unique group of small business entrepreneurs, and in recruiting quality local talent for entertainment. DMM is an active Certified Business Enterprise in DC Government’s Department of Small & Local Business Development program. Venues currently managed include: The Flea Market at Eastern Market; The Downtown Holiday Market; and The Lot SW (several events including MarketSW and SW Farmers Market), all in Washington, DC. Recently developed and managed events include Crystal City Crafts Market, Arlington, VA; and Beacon Market, Silver Spring, MD.
